correctness.rationale: PASS. The finite domain is exactly 7<=m<=16, with K_m=boundary of cyclic C(m,6) and double vertices unordered two-sets; faces are matchings whose union is a Gale-evenness facet face. Independently regenerated all Gale 6-facets, every 1/2/3-pair face, and full 2-dimensional simplicial poset for every m=7..16. Independently performed a complete sequential-toggle acyclic matching, directed-Hasse DAG topological sorting for every face, and oriented integer gradient-path Morse boundary, Hermite+Smith normal forms (with a separate program, not merely checking the reported stdout). The ten facet counts (7,16,30,50,77,112,156,210,275,352), all face vectors, critical cells and exact invariant factors agreed with source table: H1 torsion Z/3 at m=7; Z/2, Z/3, Z/4, Z/5 at m=10,12,14,16; no torsion at 8,9,11,13,15; H1 free ranks 0,15,0,24,0,35,0,48,0,63 and H2 ranks 20,78,134,263,384,610,818,1167,1484,1982. Raw and Morse modular ranks were independently cross-checked for primes 2,3,5,7. In particular m=16 Morse d2 has rank110, nonunit Smith factor5; H1=Z^63+Z/5, H2=Z^1982. The result claims only this finite range; no extrapolation to m>16.
residual_risks: The observed even-m torsion progression 2,3,4,5 is a finite staircase, not a theorem for higher m.
